solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Part of body nearly robed after losing clothing

indicators.note: clothing is the outer covering, so each of the two words is stripped of its first and last letters

explanation.surface: Someone almost fully dressed starts shedding garments, exposing part of the body.
explanation.walkthrough: 'clothing' looks like garments being removed, but it means each word's outer letters.
explanation.definitionFit: The fleshy lower lobe of the ear is one part of the human body.

clue.text: Years of retrial forgotten, off and on

indicators.note: every other letter is dropped, so only the second, fourth and sixth letters of the word survive

explanation.surface: Years of a retrial that people keep forgetting about now and then.
explanation.walkthrough: Taking the even letters of retrial gives E, R, A.
explanation.definitionFit: An era is a long period of time, a span of many years.

clue.text: Noah saw this ark shortly erected in front of boat

indicators.note: in a down clue erected means the piece is set upright, read from the bottom upwards
shortly says the word loses its final letter, cut short

parts.note: taken as written
the bow is the forward end of a vessel

explanation.surface: Noah watches his ark being put up ahead of a smaller boat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'erected' suits a down clue, where the trimmed word reads upwards; 'front of boat' is the bow, not its first letter.
explanation.definitionFit: In Genesis Noah saw the coloured arc in the sky as a sign of God's covenant after the flood.

clue.text: Perhaps Heart of Racing given another name to begin with

indicators.note: to begin with tells us to take the opening letter of each of the five words before it

explanation.surface: A racehorse called Heart of Racing is renamed at the start of its career.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Heart of Racing' reads as a horse's name; 'Perhaps Heart' is the definition, the heart being an example.
explanation.definitionFit: The heart is one example of a bodily organ, hence the 'Perhaps'.

parts.note: to egg someone on is to urge them
to head a group is to lead it

explanation.surface: A clever person's ambition to take charge.
explanation.walkthrough: The 's stands for 'is', linking definition and wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: An egghead is an informal word for an intellectual or very clever person.

clue.text: Pipe only going west and east

indicators.note: in an across clue going west means reading right to left, so the word is reversed

parts.note: but means only, as in 'but a child'

explanation.surface: A pipeline that runs only westward and eastward.
explanation.definitionFit: A tube is a hollow cylinder for carrying liquid or gas, a synonym of pipe.

indicators.note: sabotaged suggests something wrecked and disordered, so the letters are jumbled

parts.note: the letters of AT&T with the S of the possessive

explanation.surface: Someone wrecked the American phone company's European verdict, leading into the next clue.
explanation.walkthrough: The ampersand is ignored: the fodder is A, T, T, S.
explanation.definitionFit: Taste is discernment or aesthetic judgment, as in having good taste.

clue.text: … and BT lied about when connection could be made

indicators.note: about here signals the letters being moved around, rearranged

explanation.surface: Continuing the telecoms theme: BT told lies about when a phone line could be connected.
explanation.walkthrough: The telecoms surface makes 'connection' look like a phone line; it is a romantic one.
explanation.definitionFit: A meeting between two strangers set up to see if they hit it off is an occasion for a romantic connection.

parts.note: CA, short for circa, means about
a ring is given when a couple become engaged

explanation.surface: Is an engagement ring a considerate present?
explanation.definitionFit: Being caring means being considerate and kind, like being thoughtful toward others.

parts.note: GA is the postal abbreviation for the US state of Georgia
to soil something is to make it dirty

explanation.surface: Georgia producing a dirty fuel.
explanation.definitionFit: Gas oil is a type of diesel used as fuel for heating and engines.

clue.text: Blade Gunner originally? It's a myth

indicators.note: the question mark plays on the film Blade Runner: these words were once something else, so their letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Was the film Blade Runner originally called Blade Gunner? That's just a rumour.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface plays on Blade Runner, the film; the rearranged letters of Blade Gunner give the phrase.
explanation.definitionFit: An urban legend is a widely repeated modern story that is untrue, a kind of myth.

clue.text: US city's vicar in uniform raised Catholic

indicators.note: in a down clue raised means the whole run is read from the bottom upwards

parts.note: LA, Los Angeles, with the possessive S
Rev is short for Reverend, a vicar's title
taken as written
U is uniform in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: An American city's vicar in uniform was brought up a Catholic.
explanation.walkthrough: 'raised' turns LAS + REV + IN + U to read upwards.
explanation.definitionFit: Catholic in its lower-case sense means all-embracing or universal.

indicators.note: turned says the short word is flipped round to read backwards

parts.note: taken as written
a twit is a silly person

explanation.surface: One fool turned in another fool.
explanation.definitionFit: A nitwit is a stupid person, a synonym of fool.

definitions.meaning: a promotional preview advertising a film
a towed vehicle, such as a caravan, that must be pulled by a car

explanation.walkthrough: 'tower' reads as a tall building but here is one who tows.
explanation.definitionFit: A trailer is both a film preview and a wheeled vehicle pulled behind a car.

indicators.note: treated suggests something processed and reworked, so the letters are rearranged
without says letters are taken away from the word

parts.note: A and E are the two letters named, Accident and Emergency

explanation.surface: Illnesses were dealt with but not in the hospital's Accident and Emergency department.
explanation.walkthrough: Removing A and E from maladies leaves MLADIS, which 'treated' rearranges. A&E is a British hospital emergency department.
explanation.definitionFit: Dismal means dreadful or of very poor quality, as awful does.

clue.text: War poet before long supports soldiers

indicators.note: in a down clue one piece supports another by sitting beneath it

parts.note: the SAS is the British Special Air Service regiment
soon means before long

explanation.surface: A war poet who will shortly be backing the troops.
explanation.walkthrough: Siegfried Sassoon was a British poet of the First World War.
explanation.definitionFit: Siegfried Sassoon is famous for poems about the trenches of the First World War.

indicators.note: struggling suggests something in disarray, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Ireland's leader is having trouble managing a smile.
explanation.definitionFit: The Emerald Isle is a poetic nickname for Ireland, from its green countryside.

indicators.note: recalled, called back, says the word is read backwards

parts.note: to career is to race along at speed

explanation.surface: An email recalled a careers day.
explanation.walkthrough: 'career' looks like a noun but is the verb to race.
explanation.definitionFit: An e-card is a greeting card sent by email, a kind of online message.

indicators.note: breaking through says one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: a dam is a barrier holding back water
RE means about, concerning

explanation.surface: A fantasy about smashing through a barrier.
explanation.definitionFit: A dream is a fantasy or reverie imagined while awake or asleep.

indicators.note: reversed says the hidden letters are read backwards
partially says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A country's murky situation has partly gone backwards.
explanation.definitionFit: Israel is a nation in the Middle East; the 's stands for 'is', the link to the wordplay.

clue.text: Adequate individual getting rejected? That's horrible!

indicators.note: rejected, thrown back, says the word is read backwards

parts.note: one means a single individual
ugh is an exclamation of disgust

explanation.surface: Is a person good enough when they are being turned down? How awful!
explanation.definitionFit: Enough means sufficient, a synonym of adequate.

clue.text: Something said to horse missing the fence, ultimately

indicators.note: ultimately points to the final letter of each of the three words

explanation.surface: What a rider shouts at a horse that has just refused the final fence.
explanation.definitionFit: Gee, or gee up, is a command to a horse to go forward or faster.

parts.note: B is the abbreviation for black, as on pencils
an LED is a light-emitting diode

explanation.surface: A dark lamp oozed fluid.
explanation.definitionFit: Bled means gave out blood or fluid, so oozed liquid.

parts.note: Roman as in Roman Catholic
CE is the Church of England

explanation.surface: Love of the Catholic Church.
explanation.definitionFit: Romance is a love affair or the feeling of love.
